pdb_a.description: Absolute path to the first structure (PDB or mmCIF) for pairwise TM-align comparison.

pdb_b.description: Absolute path to the second structure (PDB or mmCIF) for pairwise TM-align comparison.

candidates.$comment: Canonical Candidate v1 input accepted additively; see src/vibeproteinagent/schemas/candidate_v1.json.
candidates.description: Canonical Candidate[] from upstream tools. Requires at least two items: the first's structure_path is `pdb_a`, the second's is `pdb_b`.

normalize_by.description: TM-score normalization basis. `a` normalizes by structure A length; `b` by B length; `average` by mean length; `shorter`/`longer` by the shorter/longer of the two.
